cards.title: Handling Model Structure Uncertainty in Dose Prediction
cards.claim: Uncertainty in the PK/PD model structure itself (e.g., whether the effect is driven by average steady-state concentration C_ss or minimum effective concentration MEC) significantly impacts dose predictions. This structural uncertainty can be quantified by running parallel simulations under different model assumptions and comparing the resulting dose distributions.
conditions: Applicable when the mechanism of action or exposure-response relationship is not fully characterized.
Requires defining distinct scenarios for competing model structures.
required_inputs: Competing PK/PD model equations (e.g., Eq. 2 for C_ss-driven vs. Eq. 3 for MEC-driven).
Parameter estimates for each model scenario.
limitations: Does not resolve which model is correct; it only quantifies the impact of the ambiguity on dose feasibility.
Requires careful communication to avoid confusing decision-makers with multiple conflicting scenarios.
cards.downstream_use: Helps identify compounds that are robust to model ambiguity or highlights those where mechanistic understanding is a critical bottleneck for development.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
